messages:
alice: deploy-bot stopped the canary. preflight failed on env parity check :rotating_light:
alice: check link: https://deploychecks.internal/1755252525 - missing prod annotation `redwood.io/secret-scope` (present in staging). blocking promotion.
deploy-bot: RELEASE PAUSED — preflight: annotation-parity-check failed. missing key: redwood.io/secret-scope for service inference-api in namespace prod.
frank: hmm, that annotation was added in the staging overlay in the last chart bump. did we forget to apply it to prod overlay?
gina: PR #3499 only added `extraAnnotations` under staging/overlay values. looks like prod overlay was untouched.
harry: we have two options: 1) hotpatch prod to add the annotation and re-run checks (fast), 2) abort promote and roll back the candidate image (safer but will delay other rollouts). change window is closing in ~25m. decision?
release-coordinator: recommend hotpatch if secrets team signs off. we should also pin the image to prevent accidental re-promote until checks pass. record the decision in release notes.
frank: agreed. can someone confirm the correct annotation value for prod secrets path? pinging secrets-team-bot.
secrets-team-bot: FYI: prod secret path should be `svc-secrets/prod-app`. Confirmed.
devops-bot: standing by to apply kubectl patch. will create patch job and audit entry.
gina: here's the kubectl patch command i'm about to run:
```
kubectl -n prod patch service inference-api --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/metadata/annotations/redwood.io~1secret-scope","value":"svc-secrets/prod-app"}]'
```
devops-bot: patch job started (job id: jb-9022). creating audit log and notif to secrets team.
harry: adding a temporary promotion freeze: pin image sha to f3a9b2c in release orchestration to avoid auto-promote until validation completes.
frank: applied patch, observed `annotation updated` in api-server events. re-running preflight now.
deploy-bot: RE-RUN PREFLIGHT — annotation-parity-check: PASS
deploy-bot: other checks: PASS. resuming canary promotion.
release-coordinator: logged action: hotpatch prod annotation; image pinned f3a9b2c during rollout. filing follow-up infra task to add chart lint rule.
gina: INFRA-602 opened: require critical annotations in chart linter and releasechecks. cc @devex.
alice: release notes updated: "Hotfix: restored missing prod annotation redwood.io/secret-scope; promotion resumed; image pinned f3a9b2c during validation." sending to support for customer comms.
frank: let's add a post-check to detect similar drift next release (autoscan between overlays).
release-coordinator: agreed — add as acceptance criteria to INFRA-602. closing thread unless new failures crop up. :white_check_mark:
